rows.verified: The duty to manage asbestos applies to the person with legal responsibility for relevant non-domestic premises.
Dutyholders should determine whether asbestos-containing materials could be present.
A competent asbestos surveyor is often needed to identify materials and establish their condition.
Known or presumed asbestos-containing materials should be assessed and recorded.
Dutyholders should prepare and maintain an asbestos-management plan.
The condition of asbestos-containing materials should be monitored and records updated.
People liable to disturb asbestos must receive relevant location and condition information before work starts.
Management arrangements should include suitable procedures, communication, instruction and training.
Asbestos risk depends on material type, condition, fibre release potential, disturbance, occupancy, controls, competence and work method.
HSE asbestos evidence is building-, material-, survey-, task-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level exposure probability.
Employers and people in control of premises must assess and control risks from exposure to legionella bacteria.
A competent person should be appointed to take responsibility for controlling identified legionella risks.
Water systems should be designed, maintained and operated to prevent or adequately control legionella growth.
HSE's L8 Approved Code of Practice provides practical guidance on managing legionella risks.
Technical guidance supports control in evaporative cooling, hot and cold water and other water systems.
Control arrangements should be monitored and reviewed to confirm they remain effective.
Risk control can require temperature management, system cleanliness, water movement and maintenance.
Legionnaires' disease can result from inhalation of aerosols containing legionella bacteria.
Legionella risk depends on water-system design, temperature, stagnation, aerosol generation, maintenance, monitoring, occupancy and susceptibility.
HSE legionella evidence is system-, premises-, control-, exposure-, person- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
